configs.name: Pathanamthitta
configs.terrain: Central midland agricultural corridor along Pamba & Achankovil river valleys
configs.hazardProfile: Flash floods, riverine overflow, reservoir catchment surges
configs.limitations: Cell represents the populated midland basin; does not cover the eastern Sabarimala/Ranni high-altitude forest reserves (>1000m MSL).

configs.name: Idukki
configs.terrain: High-relief Western Ghats plateau (826m MSL) centered on the Idukki Dam & Reservoir
configs.hazardProfile: High-slope runoff, reservoir inflow surges, slope destabilization
configs.limitations: Cell models the central Periyar reservoir catchment; does not capture the extreme orographic precipitation of Munnar/High Ranges (10.00°N, 77.00°E, >1600m MSL).

configs.name: Wayanad
configs.terrain: Elevated agricultural plateau (766m MSL) centered on Mananthavady & Kabini basin
configs.hazardProfile: Localized cloudburst runoff, plateau drainage congestion
configs.limitations: Cell represents the high interior plateau; excludes the extreme landslide-vulnerable western escarpment (Vythiri-Meppadi, 11.50°N, 76.00°E) to prevent boundary mixing with Kozhikode plains.

configs.name: Kottayam
configs.terrain: Low midland undulating hills and alluvial plain draining into Vembanad Lake
configs.limitations: Cell represents the central midland and Vembanad wetlands margin; does not cover the eastern Western Ghat foothills near Kanjirappally/Poonjar.

configs.name: Ernakulam
configs.terrain: Coastal plains, urban delta, shipping channels & estuarine floodplains (3m MSL)
configs.hazardProfile: Urban flash flooding, tidal lockage, high economic & infrastructure exposure
configs.limitations: Cell covers Greater Cochin and the coastal marine boundary; does not reflect the eastern forested midlands near Kothamangalam.

configs.name: Thiruvananthapuram
configs.terrain: State capital midlands, Karamana basin, and historic IMD Observatory Hill (22m MSL)
configs.hazardProfile: Urban drainage overflow, localized severe convection
configs.limitations: Cell directly covers the city and IMD Regional Centre; does not cover the southern Western Ghat crest at Agasthyamala/Ponmudi (>1500m MSL).
